tools.name: search_posts
tools.title: Search Posts
tools.description: Search posts by keyword and/or tag IDs. Returns paginated results: {items, total, page, page_size}. All parameters are optional; omitting everything returns the latest posts.

tools.name: get_post
tools.title: Get Post
tools.description: Retrieve a single post by UUID. Returns the full post object including content, tags, like count, and timestamps.

tools.name: list_tags
tools.title: List Tags
tools.description: List every tag in the system. Each entry contains the tag id, name, and usage count. No parameters needed.

tools.name: create_post
tools.title: Create Post
tools.description: Create a new post. At least one of content, echo_files, or extension must be provided. Returns {id, message}. To attach files, upload them first via the REST API (POST <base_url>/api/files/upload, multipart/form-data, field 'file') and pass the returned id values in echo_files. Read the resource ech0://guide/file-upload for full upload instructions.

tools.name: update_post
tools.title: Update Post
tools.description: Update an existing post. Only supplied fields are changed, except echo_files and extension which fully replace the existing values when provided. Returns {id, message}.

tools.name: delete_post
tools.title: Delete Post
tools.description: Permanently delete a post. Returns {id, message}. This action cannot be undone.

tools.name: get_today_posts
tools.title: Get Today's Posts
tools.description: Return all posts created today. The boundary of 'today' depends on the timezone parameter. Returns an array of post objects.

tools.name: like_post
tools.title: Like Post
tools.description: Increment the like (favourite) count of a post by one. Returns {id, message}.

tools.name: delete_tag
tools.title: Delete Tag
tools.description: Delete a tag and remove its association from all posts. Returns {id, message}. This action cannot be undone.

tools.name: get_hot_posts
tools.title: Get Hot Posts
tools.description: Return the most popular posts, ranked by a weighted score of likes and comment count. Returns an array of post objects.

tools.name: get_random_post
tools.title: Get Random Post
tools.description: Return a single randomly selected post. Returns the post object, or null if there are no posts. No parameters needed.

tools.name: get_on_this_day_posts
tools.title: Get On This Day Posts
tools.description: Return posts from past years that share the same month and day as today ('on this day' / this day in history). The day boundary depends on the timezone parameter. Returns an array of post objects.

tools.name: list_comments
tools.title: List Comments
tools.description: List approved public comments for a post (equivalent to GET /api/comments with echo_id). Returns comment objects including nickname, content, created_at, and status when applicable.

tools.name: create_integration_comment
tools.title: Create Integration Comment
tools.description: Create a trusted integration/AI comment using the same backend as POST /api/comments/integration: no captcha or form_token; source is marked integration; subject to integration rate limits and duplicate checks. Requires comment:write. See resource ech0://guide/integration-comment for the REST equivalent (curl) and audience rules.

tools.name: create_comment
tools.title: Create Comment (Integration)
tools.description: Alias of create_integration_comment. Prefer this name in agent workflows; behavior and requirements are identical.

tools.name: list_files
tools.title: List Files
tools.description: List uploaded file metadata with optional search and storage type filter. Returns paginated results: {items, total, page, page_size}. Each item's id can be used as echo_files[].file_id in create_post/update_post. Does not return file contents.

tools.name: get_file
tools.title: Get File
tools.description: Get metadata for a single file (name, size, mime type, storage type, URL, timestamps). The id can be used as echo_files[].file_id in create_post/update_post. Does not return file contents.

tools.name: delete_file
tools.title: Delete File
tools.description: Permanently delete a file from storage. Returns {id, message}. This action cannot be undone.

tools.name: create_external_file
tools.title: Create External File
tools.description: Register an external URL as an Ech0 file record (no upload needed). Returns the created file metadata including id, which can be used as echo_files[].file_id in create_post/update_post.

tools.name: list_connects
tools.title: List Connects
tools.description: List all saved peer connections (id and URL). These are the remote Ech0 instances the current instance is tracking.

tools.name: get_connects_info
tools.title: Get Connects Info
tools.description: Fetch aggregated public info (name, URL, logo, post stats, version) for every saved peer. Data is cached for 30 minutes; the first call after expiry may take a few seconds as the server fans out HTTP requests to each peer.

tools.name: add_connect
tools.title: Add Connect
tools.description: Add a remote Ech0 instance as a peer connection. The connect_url must point to the /connect endpoint of the remote instance (e.g. https://example.com/api/connect). Returns {id, message}.

tools.name: delete_connect
tools.title: Delete Connect
tools.description: Remove a saved peer connection by ID. Returns {id, message}. This action cannot be undone.

tools.name: get_recent
tools.title: Get Recent Summary
tools.description: Return an AI-generated natural-language summary of the site owner's recent activity. The result is cached and may take a few seconds on first call if the cache has expired.

tools.name: list_webhooks
tools.title: List Webhooks
tools.description: List all configured webhooks. Returns an array of webhook objects (id, name, url, is_active, last_status, last_trigger, timestamps). Secrets are never exposed.

tools.name: create_webhook
tools.title: Create Webhook
tools.description: Create a new webhook endpoint. Returns {message} on success.

tools.name: update_webhook
tools.title: Update Webhook
tools.description: Update an existing webhook by ID. All fields in the body replace the current values. Returns {id, message}.

tools.name: delete_webhook
tools.title: Delete Webhook
tools.description: Delete a webhook by ID. Returns {id, message}. This action cannot be undone.

tools.name: test_webhook
tools.title: Test Webhook
tools.description: Send a test POST request to the webhook endpoint. Returns {id, message} indicating whether the test was dispatched.

resources.name: tags
resources.title: All Tags
resources.description: JSON array of all tags. Each object has id, name, and the number of posts using this tag.

resources.name: recent_posts
resources.title: Recent Posts
resources.description: The 20 most recently created posts (newest first). Append ?limit=N (1–100) to the URI to change the count.

resources.name: profile
resources.title: Current User Profile
resources.description: JSON object with id, username, email, avatar URL, and admin flag of the token owner.

resources.name: recent_comments
resources.title: Recent Comments
resources.description: The 20 most recent approved public comments across all posts, newest first.

resources.name: integration_comment_guide
resources.title: Integration Comment Guide
resources.description: REST and MCP usage for posting integration/AI comments without captcha (same as POST /api/comments/integration).

resources.name: file_upload_guide
resources.title: File Upload Guide
resources.description: Step-by-step instructions for uploading files via the REST API so they can be referenced in create_post/update_post echo_files.

resources.name: heatmap
resources.title: Post Heatmap
resources.description: Daily post counts for the past 30 calendar days (UTC day boundaries). Returns an array of {date, count} objects, suitable for calendar heatmap rendering.

resources.name: connect_self
resources.title: Current Instance Info
resources.description: Public card of this Ech0 instance: server name, URL, logo, today/total post counts, owner username, and version.

resources.name: visitor_stats
resources.title: Visitor Stats
resources.description: Daily visitor statistics (page views and unique visitors) for the past 7 days (UTC day boundaries). Returns an array of {date, pv, uv} objects. Requires admin scope.

resource_templates.name: post
resource_templates.title: Post by ID
resource_templates.description: Full post object (content, tags, timestamps, like count) for a given UUID. Replace {id} with the post UUID.
